SsrHeroDays.meaning: hero node: calendar days to expiry

SsrHeroSkew.meaning: hero node ATM skew s0 (vol per unit log-moneyness)

SsrMarkVolPct.meaning: today's vol at the marked k=-0.10 strike, %

SsrMarkSpreadBp.meaning: spread of the marked strike's vol across regimes at the fan move (R=0 minus R=2 readings), vol bp

SsrSignQuoteVolPct.meaning: vol of the tracked fixed strike, %

SsrDialAtmMoveBp.meaning: linear ATM response R s0 H at the fan move for R=2, vol bp

SsrDialBendBp.meaning: second-order ATM bend at H=-6% under R=1 (sticky-strike), vol bp

SsrDeltaGapPts.meaning: R=0 vs R=2 total-delta gap at the marked strike, delta pts

SsrDeltaMaxPts.meaning: largest regime delta gap across the span, delta pts

SsrDeltaMarkPutDelta.meaning: Black forward put delta magnitude at the marked strike, pts

SsrHalfSlopeLoc.meaning: generator vol slope per unit log-strike

SsrHalfSlopeImp.meaning: measured implied ATM skew of the generator at tau=0.10

SsrHalfRatio.meaning: measured implied-to-local slope ratio at tau=0.10

SsrHalfAtmMoveBp.meaning: measured ATM change after the frozen-field -4% move, vol bp

SsrHalfAtmPredBp.meaning: half-rule prediction 2 s0 H, vol bp

SsrHalfGapPutBp.meaning: relabeling-vs-linear gap at k=-0.24 under a -5% move, bp

SsrHalfGapCallBp.meaning: relabeling-vs-linear gap at k=+0.15 under a -5% move, bp

SsrRepTcmp.meaning: maturity of the two-field comparison, years

SsrRepAtmLogBp.meaning: log-strike field: repriced ATM response to the move, vol bp

SsrRepAtmDlrBp.meaning: dollar-strike field: repriced ATM response to the move, vol bp

SsrRepSepPutBp.meaning: wing separation of the two answers at k=-0.30, vol bp

SsrRepSepCallBp.meaning: wing separation of the two answers at k=+0.30, vol bp

SsrRepFlatShort.meaning: straight-line field: realized ratio at the shortest maturity

SsrRepFlatLong.meaning: straight-line field: realized ratio at the longest maturity

SsrRepFlatSpread.meaning: straight-line field: max-min spread of the ratio across maturities

SsrRepBentMean.meaning: bent field: mean realized ratio across maturities at H=-2%

SsrRepBentBigMean.meaning: bent field: mean realized ratio across maturities at H=-4%

SsrRepAuditPct.meaning: dt-check: relative change of the bent field's ratio at the comparison maturity between dt and dt/4, %

SsrScenShortAtmMovePts.meaning: shortest expiry: spread of the ATM readings between R=0 and R=2 under the scenario, vol pts

SsrScenLongAtmMovePts.meaning: longest expiry: spread of the ATM readings between R=0 and R=2 under the scenario, vol pts

SsrScenGapShortPts.meaning: 25-delta-put delta gap at the shortest expiry, delta pts

SsrScenGapLongPts.meaning: 25-delta-put delta gap at the longest expiry, delta pts

SsrScenGapHeroPts.meaning: 25-delta-put delta gap at the hero expiry, delta pts

SsrScenShortReindexPct.meaning: shortest expiry: sticky-strike ATM after the move, the fit read at k = H, %

SsrScenShortRzeroPct.meaning: shortest expiry: sticky-moneyness ATM after the move (= today's, exactly), %

SsrScenShortRtwoPct.meaning: shortest expiry: R=2 ATM after the move, the fit read at k = 2H, %

SsrScenRootScaledSkew.meaning: the two-day skew scaled by sqrt(tau) to the hero maturity (the 1/sqrt(tau)-decay prediction), absolute value

SsrMarkSlope.meaning: today's smile slope at the marked k=-0.10 strike

SsrDialBendTwoBp.meaning: second-order ATM bend at H=-6% under R=2, vol bp

SsrDialBendRatio.meaning: ratio of the R=2 bend to the R=1 bend at H=-6% (about 4)

SsrDeltaMaxK.meaning: log-moneyness where the regime delta gap peaks

SsrDeltaAtmPts.meaning: regime delta gap at the money, delta pts

SsrScenShortLinearPts.meaning: shortest expiry: the linear law's R=2 ATM response 2|s0 H|, vol pts

SsrScenSlopeShort.meaning: smile slope at the shortest expiry's 25-delta put

SsrScenSlopeHero.meaning: smile slope at the hero expiry's 25-delta put

SsrScenSlopeLong.meaning: smile slope at the longest expiry's 25-delta put
